scope_note: Born-digital Diário do Congresso Nacional issue from the Senate's diary store (viewer https://legis.senado.leg.br/diarios/ver/3422; PDF page 3 is printed page 1). The cover and running heads print Saturday 1 January 2011 (used as published_date), while the Senate's metadata gives 2 January 2011; the opening misspells the name 'Dilma Roussef'.

visual_review.method: PDF pages 1, 4, 8 and 9 rendered and read (cover, the TSE diploma, declaration and termo, the signed termo); Rousseff's and Sarney's addresses (PDF pages 10-15) read from the text layer. CLAUDE-C01-17 (br_vice_president rows): PDF pages 3 (opening), 5 (the Vice-President's TSE diploma), 7 (his oath and signed termo de compromisso), 8 (declaration and typed termo) and 9 (signed termo de posse) rendered and read; pages 10 and 15 read from the text layer.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer were elected on 31 October 2010; the reproduced TSE diploma says Dilma Vana Rousseff, candidate of the Para o Brasil Seguir Mudando coalition, was elected President of the Federative Republic of Brazil by the will expressed at the polls on 31 October 2010.

locator.section: Opening declaration by José Sarney; diploma on pdf p. 4 (printed p. 2)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The reproduced TSE diploma, dated Brasília 17 December 2010 and signed by Minister Ricardo Lewandowski as President of the Court, qualifies her for investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 2011; the opening and termo date the diplomação to 17 December 2010.

locator.section: Facsimile of the TSE diploma (printed sideways)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 2011 (14:47-15:55), José Sarney invited the President of the Republic to take the constitutional commitment, and Dilma Rousseff recited it.

locator.section: "A SRª DILMA ROUSSEFF - Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição..."; compromisso facsimile follows

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: José Sarney, "with the powers conferred on me by the Constitution", declared Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 1 January 2011 to 31 December 2014; the session was opened to give posse to the two, diplomados for the period beginning on that date.

locator.section: Left column: "declaro empossados ... para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2011 a 31 de dezembro de 2014"; opening on pdf p. 3 (printed p. 1)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The termo de posse records that at 14:30 on 1 January 2011, before the National Congress in joint session in the Chamber plenary, Dilma Rousseff was solemnly empossada as President of the Republic under article 78 of the Constitution, elected on 31 October 2010 and diplomada on 17 December 2010, for the period 1 January 2011 to 31 December 2014.

locator.section: Termo read (both columns); signed facsimile on pdf p. 9 (printed p. 7)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In her address to the session Rousseff says that "today" the presidential sash will for the first time be placed on a woman's shoulder.

locator.section: Opening of Dilma Rousseff's address ("hoje será a primeira vez que a faixa presidencial cingirá o ombro de uma mulher")

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his closing address to the session the President of Congress, José Sarney, tells Dilma Rousseff that 'here, at this moment', she accepts the responsibility of governing the country, and that through this commitment 'a Presidente eleita assume a responsabilidade que a Constituição lhe impõe'.

locator.section: Sarney's address ('Aqui, neste momento, Vossa Excelência aceita a responsabilidade de governar o País'; 'através deste compromisso a Presidente eleita assume a responsabilidade que a Constituição lhe impõe')

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer were elected on 31 October 2010; the reproduced TSE diploma says Michel Miguel Elias Temer Lulia, candidate of the Para o Brasil Seguir Mudando coalition, was elected Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil by the will expressed at the polls on 31 October 2010.

locator.section: Opening by José Sarney ("eleitos em 31 de outubro de 2010"); diploma on pdf p. 5 (printed p. 3)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The reproduced TSE diploma, dated Brasília 17 December 2010 and signed by Minister Ricardo Lewandowski as President of the Court, qualifies Michel Miguel Elias Temer Lulia for investiture in the office of Vice-President before the National Congress on 1 January 2011; the opening and his termo de compromisso date the diplomação to 17 December 2010.

locator.section: Facsimile of the Vice-President's TSE diploma, printed sideways ("Brasília, 17 de dezembro de 2010")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 2011 (14:47-15:55), after Rousseff, José Sarney invited "o Excelentíssimo Vice-Presidente da República eleito, Sr. Michel Temer" to take the constitutional commitment, and he recited it; the record reproduces his signed termo de compromisso under article 78, "prestado em 1º de janeiro de 2011", naming him as elected to the office of Vice-President on 31 October 2010 and diplomado on 17 December 2010.

locator.section: "O SR. MICHEL TEMER - Prometo manter..."; boxed facsimile "TERMO DE COMPROMISSO ... PRESTADO EM 1º DE JANEIRO DE 2011"

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: José Sarney, "with the powers conferred on me by the Constitution", declared Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 1 January 2011 to 31 December 2014; the session was opened to give posse to the two, diplomados "para o período a iniciar-se nesta data".

locator.section: Left column: "declaro empossados, nos cargos de Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil, a Excelentíssima Senhora Dilma Rousseff e o Excelentíssimo Senhor Michel Temer, para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2011 a 31 de dezembro de 2014"; opening on pdf p. 3

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The joint termo de posse records that at 14:30 on 1 January 2011, before the National Congress in joint session, Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer were solemnly empossados under article 78 of the Constitution in the offices of President and Vice-President, elected on 31 October 2010 and diplomados on 17 December 2010, for the period 1 January 2011 to 31 December 2014.

locator.section: Typed termo (both columns); signed facsimile on pdf p. 9 (printed p. 7)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the posse, Rousseff's address salutes "Sr. Vice-Presidente da República, Michel Temer", and the Congress President's closing address tells her that she has at her side "o Vice-Presidente Michel Temer".

locator.section: Salutation of Rousseff's address (text layer); Sarney's address on pdf p. 15 (printed p. 13)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In her address at the 2011 posse, Rousseff pays homage to "nosso querido Vice-Presidente José Alencar", the companion who was at President Lula's side "nesses oito anos", and says that she and the Vice-President, Michel Temer, feel responsible for following the path they began.

locator.section: Rousseff's address ("Quero, neste momento, prestar minha homenagem ... nosso querido Vice-Presidente José Alencar!")

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 (rows with role_id br_president) and Vice-President observations for CLAUDE-C01-17 (rows with role_id br_vice_president). Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, the Vice-President's succession, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Vice-President's exercise of the office recorded by CLAUDE-C01-10 stays on br_president rows; ministers and party offices are excluded.
